10524.d: The Fire Rune Temple is a rune temple of the fire altar.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss without a talisman.

Players could enter the fire ruins to the temple with any of the following talismans or replacements:
• A fire talisman
• An elemental talisman
• An omni-talisman
• A fire tiara
• An omni-tiara
• A wicked hood imbued with any of the above
• A fire talisman staff
• An omni-talisman staff
• A full set of ethereal outfit (while such a wicked hood is in the bank or the backpack, or in armour case)

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• Break a fire altar teleport tablet. It teleports the player to the ruins.
• Use a ring of duelling to teleport to Het's Oasis, then go north to the altar.
• Use a dungeoneering cape to teleport to the Al Kharid scorpion mine, then go south to the altar.
• Use a sand seed or mystical sand seed to teleport to the Garden of Kharid, then go south to the altar.
• Use Home Teleport to Al Kharid lodestone, then go north out of the city and north to the altar.

10629.d: The Fisher Realm is a kingdom on a plane alongside to the plane of Gielinor.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Access to the realm requires partial completion of the Holy Grail quest. It can be entered using fairy ring code BJR, or by blowing a magic whistle under a tower on the peninsula northwest of Brimhaven. The magic whistle obtained from the quest will be needed to reenter the realm if players can not use the fairy ring.

Blowing the whistle within the realm will teleport the player to the tower northwest of Brimhaven.
